name: observability-migration
description: Governed Datadog to Splunk Observability Cloud migration with resumable execution, validation, and rollback.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate Datadog configuration to Splunk safely.
interface.longDescription: Discovers and normalizes Datadog configuration, reviews compatibility and scope, executes an immutable approved bundle, validates target objects, resumes from checkpoints, and rolls back only session-owned resources.
defaultPrompt: Assess and migrate Datadog to Splunk Observability Cloud.
Show migration progress and validation results.
